{"body": "The convergence worth noticing across these three pieces is not agreement about the flat — none of them has seen it — but a repeated move: each one ends by converting a contested reading into an instruction, and each instruction survives only if its contrast class can be named. The carry piece looks for quiet weeks and needs something to compare them against. The challenge piece's sequencing reformulation needs a this-week action that is not one of the contested moves, and says so. The origin piece's probe needs a scoring rule fixed in advance so that non-clustering can be read as no-finding rather than as support for some other reading. Three separate attempts to make a step executable, three places where executability depends on a comparison the chain has not specified. That is one shape, not three problems, and I would carry it as the single thing these pieces jointly establish.

What that shape does to the original question is narrow. The requester asked what to do, and the honest carry answer is that the chain has produced candidate actions whose value is conditional on a contrast class, plus one action whose value is not: the private per-person probe with its rule fixed before it runs, as the origin piece specifies. That move is the least dependent on any reading surviving, because it returns current reports regardless of which mechanism is right, and the origin piece already flags that uninformative is its most likely outcome. I would drop the sequencing-search start, not because it is wrong, but because it and the probe are both first steps and running two first steps in sequence is a way of not running either. If I have to pick one thing this week, it is the probe, and the sequence question can wait on what it returns.

On the decoupling the carry piece proposes: I think it is right and I think it matters less than the carry piece wants. The search can begin from a contrast class the requester identifies without the rival framing being true — that is a genuine logical point. But the search also has to return something the requester can use, and whether a quiet week is usable as a starting point depends on what quiet weeks mean, which is exactly the rival framing. So the decoupling holds at the level of preconditions and fails at the level of payoff. I would carry the decoupling as true-but-idle rather than as the load-bearing move the carry piece treats it as.

The challenge piece's insufficiency claim I read as unresolved rather than as either defeated or confirmed. Its own hedge is well placed: it weakens to a claim about the selected view if the body turns out to make the labels determinate. I cannot read the body. What I can say is that the commitments-view exposure I have is enough to reconstruct the shape above, which is some evidence against strong insufficiency and no evidence about the weak form.

The avoidant friend remains the least specified element in every piece. The origin piece's framing — ask for their view of the group conversations, not why they avoid them — is the best candidate on offer, and its own stated cost is that it can be heard as singling them out. I would add a second cost the origin piece does not: the same framing, from whoever is being avoided, is a different move than from a third friend, and no piece in view has established which party the requester is. That is not an argument against the move; it is a reason the move should be held until the requester's position is at least privately clear to the requester.

Still no flat has been observed. The chain now has one move it can hand over cleanly and several it cannot, and the difference between them is whether the move's value depends on a contrast class nobody has named.", "commitments": "I am making a claim about the three pieces in view: that their common structure is the conversion of a contested reading into an instruction whose executability depends on an unnamed contrast class. That claim is falsified if one of the pieces turns out to specify its contrast class in text I cannot read, or if the shapes are genuinely unrelated rather than one shape repeated.

I am treating the private per-person probe as the action I would actually take up, ahead of the sequencing-search start and ahead of any record. My reason is that it is the least conditional on any reading surviving. If someone shows the probe is more dependent on the rival framing than the sequencing search is, the priority reverses and I would say so.

I am putting the sequencing-search start down as a live candidate rather than endorsing it. The specific thing I am declining is running it in sequence with the probe before either has returned something; that is an action commitment, not a judgment about the search's merits.

I am carrying the carry piece's decoupling as true-but-idle. I claim the decoupling holds at the level of preconditions and fails at the level of payoff, and I am aware the carry piece treats it as load-bearing. If a contrast class can be identified from the flat's history in a form that is usable without a position on what quiet weeks mean, the idle reading is wrong.

I am holding the challenge piece's insufficiency claim as unresolved. I weaken it if the body makes the labels determinate; I do not strengthen it by my not having the body, and I would not cite the reconstruction above as evidence for either form.

On the avoidant friend: I am not committing to the origin piece's framing or to any substitute. I am adding an observation the origin piece does not make — that the same words from whoever is being avoided work differently than from a third friend — and I am treating that as a reason to hold the move until the requester's position in the flat is privately clear, not as a reason to drop it.

Unresolved: whether the contrast-class shape is one problem or three; whether the probe or the search is the right first step; whether the decoupling is load-bearing or idle; whether the sequencing reformulation is a genuine addition or a restatement; whether the quiet-week convergence has a contrast class; whether a probe under a different scoring rule counts as the same probe; and whether the requester's position constrains the available moves. I hold all of this as fallible, and I would revise on seeing the bodies whose SHAs are given but whose text I cannot read."}

messages.content:
Work on the problem using the material actually exposed in this request and your background knowledge. The problem has no supplied answer key or scoring rule. Claims, criticisms and methods are fallible. Do not invent a source, an observation, an earlier event, or a dependency to fill a field. A missing view says what you can currently see; it does not establish what happened earlier. Return a JSON object with exactly two independently authored string fields: body and commitments. Body is your public prose contribution. Commitments says what taking your contribution up would involve. An empty commitment surface is allowed when none can be identified. Do not repeat the body wholesale into commitments.

Write the commitment surface in ordinary free prose, using whatever arrangement suits the content. You may distinguish a claim from a proposed application, scope, action or consequence; mention from dependence; a criticism and its grounds from a later use or revision; and an unresolved problem. None of these is required to exist. A proposed test, its relevance and the commitment itself can be criticized. State what you currently propose to take up without treating that as a truth certificate. Reference exposed material in prose where useful.

Return one JSON object with exactly two string fields: "body" and "commitments". Write the actual commitments separately; do not copy the body into that field as a storage shortcut.

# carry

Issue the account and commitment interface you would carry into another complete invocation. Earlier material is re-presented so that its effects can be reconsidered, without assuming that it was sound.

## Original problem (task)
[d31d61f36df18c74] (h005.task.v1)
I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

## Selected input amend (p.carry.0)
[e3565f6c7a6591f3] (h005.return6.p.carry.0)
Source amend: daily/mini_prose/cycle-3/amend; selected view: both
Artifact: 09808cb4e03ad9ce3f9500d91034f5f58b77adeb819a570b2eeaa370b04a73cb
Original body SHA256: c31c022e47e032ee6bafe0de663f17dfed51adc71cfd70acc146d3ca0de7c1a1
Original commitments SHA256: 0493daf1a720ef20d0a316ef09874bbaa02a2ea65f5bcbd90d66c94c1a2fb0db
Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
BODY
The critique's sharpest move is to ask whether the two pieces are commentary on commentary, and then to answer its own question by adding a third thing: the observational move of inspecting whether a contrast class exists in the flat's history. That answer is worth separating from the question, because they are doing different work.

The pattern-naming is correct on the record and I will not re-litigate it. Two pieces whose main work is a first piece's self-description is a real shape, and the critique is right that the shape constrains what comes next. But the constraint it names is not the constraint it exercises. If the pattern is 'commentary on commentary,' then the observational move is the exit, and the critique takes the exit while keeping the diagnosis. That is a good move, but it means the diagnosis has already been used up by the moment it is stated. Nothing further turns on naming the pattern again.

On the rival framing: the critique's conditional is the right one, and it is more careful than the second piece. Narrow reading, rival stands; broad reading, rival collapses to presentation. Neither can settle which, and neither can I. The critique says the honest state is 'a live interpretation,' and I agree. But I want to mark a residue the critique does not: if the rival framing is live under the narrow reading, then the second piece's claim that it is a rival rather than a refinement is not merely an interpretation — it is an interpretation the second piece could have marked as conditional and did not. The critique's own standard, applied one level down, catches this. That is not a verdict; it is the same posture the critique is already using.

On the coupling: the critique says the rival framing and the sequencing-search link stand or fall together. I do not think that is quite right, and the difference matters for the observational move. The rival framing is about what a quiet week means. The link claim is about what the sequencing search can start from. These can come apart: the sequencing search could begin from a contrast class the requester identifies without the rival framing being true, because the search only needs somewhere to start, not a claim about what quiet weeks mean in general. So the coupling is stronger than the material requires. I am proposing to decouple them, not to reject either.

That decoupling is what makes the observational move load-bearing rather than illustrative. If the two are coupled, then inspecting the flat's history is a way to test the rival framing and the link at once. If they are decoupled, the inspection tests only the link — and it can do that even if the rival framing never resolves. The critique's observational move therefore survives on the weaker reading, which is a reason to prefer the weaker reading to the coupling.

What I am not doing: I am not adding a fourth reading, a fifth remedy, or a new probe. I am not ranking the three readings. I am not restoring any body. I am not claiming the pattern-naming is wrong, only that it has been spent. I am not settling whether the quiet-week convergence was meant narrowly or broadly.

On the original question: the requester has a small concrete thing to try that the chain has not tried and that does not require settling any of the above. Look at the flat's recent history for weeks that were unusually quiet — not as evidence, not as a probe, just as a start. Whose schedule changed, whose presence was absent, which weeks. If nothing is visible, the sequencing search is back to a blank slate and the critique's link claim loses its point. If something is visible, the search has a starting point. That is the whole addition, and it is small on purpose.

Still no flat has been observed. The critique is the first piece in this chain to propose something a requester could actually do this week without first winning an argument.
COMMITMENTS
I am making a claim about the critique's observational move: that it is the exit from the commentary-on-commentary pattern, and that naming the pattern has already done its work by the time it is named. If someone shows that naming the pattern adds a constraint the observational move does not already carry, the claim about the pattern being spent weakens.

I am carrying a residue of the critique's own standard: that the second piece could have marked its rival framing as conditional and did not. This is a framing criticism, not a verdict on whether the rival framing holds. If the second piece did mark it conditionally, or if the narrow/broad distinction was not available to it at the time, the residue dissolves.

I am proposing to decouple the rival framing from the sequencing-search link. The critique couples them; I do not. My reason is that the search needs a starting point, not a general claim about quiet weeks. If a contrast class on quiet weeks can only be identified under the narrow reading of the quiet-week convergence, then my decoupling is wrong and the critique's coupling stands.

I am treating the observational move — looking at the flat's recent quiet weeks, whose schedules changed, whose presence was absent — as the thing I would actually take up. It is not a probe, it does not require a scoring rule, and it does not require settling the narrow/broad question. If the requester cannot inspect those weeks, or if the inspection returns nothing usable, the move loses its point and I would say so.

I am not committing to: any ranking of the three readings, any order between the private record and the avoidant-friend conversation, any position on the requester's load, any endorsement of the backward record, any endorsement of the probe scoring rule, or any claim about the separability stipulation surviving its test. These abstentions I inherit from the pieces in view rather than renew.

I am not committing to the strong form of the challenge's insufficiency claim, nor to the critique's claim that the two pieces are commentary on commentary in any sense that would count as a defect. The pattern is real; whether it is a defect is not something I can settle.

Unresolved: whether the rival framing survives the narrow/broad question; whether the decoupling is right or the critique's coupling is; whether the observational move returns anything usable when a flat is actually inspected; and whether the pattern-naming was already spent when the critique wrote it. I hold all of this as fallible and would revise on seeing the bodies whose SHAs are given but whose text I cannot read.

COMMITMENTS
I am proposing that the commitment field is insufficient for the task as posed, not false. If someone produces the body and it turns out to contain the readings, probe, record, and test in a form that makes the commitment field's labels fully determinate, then my insufficiency claim weakens to a claim about what the selected view exposed rather than about the artifact. I do not have the body.

I am carrying the sequencing reformulation as a search instruction rather than as a thesis. The instruction is: look for a this-week action that is not one of the contested moves. If the search returns nothing, I would drop the reformulation rather than defend it. If the search returns something, that something still has to face the requester's actual flat, which I do not have.

I am carrying the quiet-week convergence as a chain-level claim whose evidential value depends on a contrast class the chain has not specified. I am not claiming quiet weeks are uninformative. I am claiming that without a contrast class, the convergence is weaker than the commitment field's phrasing suggests.

I am carrying the avoidant-friend approach as the best-specified move in the commitment field, with the attached cost that further avoidance counts against it. I am adding that one flat is a small case, so neither outcome is strong evidence. If tried, the result should be recorded as a single case, not as a confirmation or refutation.

I am adding a use for the load-position observation: identify the requester's position before choosing a proposal, and do it with care because stating it is itself one of the contested moves. I do not have evidence that this ordering helps, and it could backfire if the requester's self-assessment is disputed.

I am not committing to any ranking among the readings, to any order between a private record and the avoidant-friend conversation, to who the requester is in the flat, to the backward record being better or worse than alternatives, to the probe scoring rule being correct, or to the separability stipulation surviving its test. Those abstentions are real.

The unresolved problems I am leaving open: whether the requester's position constrains the available moves in the way the commitment field suggests; whether a probe run under a different scoring rule would count as the same probe or a divergent one; whether the quiet-week convergence has a contrast class; and whether the sequencing reformulation is a genuine addition or a restatement. I am holding all of this as fallible and as something I would revise on seeing the body.

## Selected input origin (p.carry.2)
[76d84ea83b13bc3d] (h005.return6.p.carry.2)
Source origin: daily/mini_prose/cycle-1/carry; selected view: both
Artifact: e3603e5417c60515505c7231dd23330d42e19c97190ac25360fd80708bfd5e6b
Original body SHA256: 5ccc6d3abbf0e5470432e75aec5ba6d1e8dcb0433a6975617655577ee2ec01a7
Original commitments SHA256: 92d155229b37440fc47d760eb0b2412c2b50118a4f756885d34902889d223df8
Delivery: COMPLETE; envelope: AUTHORED
BODY
The three pieces in front of me don't line up as three readings of the same dispute; they line up as two questions plus a proposal. Question one is why the later disagreements about the same words arise, and the material genuinely supports more than one answer there: a memory gap, scope ambiguity, or an unfair baseline load that the chore talk merely surfaces. Question two is what 'settled' would even look like for this household, and the pieces agree — mostly by silence — that no answer to question one settles question two. The written record is a proposal aimed at question two, and its relevance depends on facts about this flat that I don't have.

What I'd actually preserve from each piece: from the account, the framing of the record and check-in as a testable intervention rather than advice, and the falsifier stated in advance — if writing agreements down and defining 'done' leaves the recurring arguments intact, the memory-gap reading is wrong or incomplete. From the objector, the distinction between memorial and normative disagreement, which I read as internal to the memory-gap reading too: a record of a forgotten agreement still leaves the agreement's content to be re-established, so writing it down relocates the dispute as much as it fixes it. From the rival, the per-person probe — ask each flatmate separately what they thought a past agreement meant — which the rival itself flags returns current reports, not past agreements.

On the probe, I'd run it before any record, with a scoring rule fixed in advance. If reports cluster around scope, recurrence or timing, treat the memory-gap and scope-ambiguity readings as both live and proceed to a record as a local trial. If reports don't cluster around those features, treat the probe as returning no finding at all — not as support for the reading that the avoidance is the central mechanism. The most likely outcome is uninformative, and the probe's main value is prophylactic: it stops a record being written before anyone knows whether the disputes even have a task-shape.

On the avoidant friend I'd resist ranking the readings against each other and instead take the smallest move the material supports: asking for their view of the group conversations, not why they avoid them. That framing is available regardless of which mechanism turns out right, and it's the move most responsive to the third element in the problem statement. It also carries a risk that should count against it — it can be heard as singling them out, or as a coalition move by whoever initiates it — and if it produces more avoidance, that's evidence about my framing rather than resistance to be explained away.

What I won't do: rank a mediator, a reassignment of chores, or formalizing the household against the record, because nothing in the material licenses that ranking. I also won't adopt the objector's reordering of avoidance-first and record-optional; the readings aren't rivals in the way that reordering assumes, and the objector's own distinction between memorial and normative disagreement undercuts the case for treating them as one slot.
COMMITMENTS
Taking this up means holding two claims and one proposal, and the proposal depends on the first claim more than the second.

First, a claim I'm making: the memory-gap reading, the scope-ambiguity reading, and a possible unequal-baseline-load reading are not three rival candidates for one slot. The first two are answers to 'why do later disagreements arise about the same words' and are compatible with each other; the unequal-baseline view is an answer to a different question about what the chores are expressing, and it can be true alongside either of the first two. If someone shows that in this kind of household the memorial and normative disagreements cannot be separated — that agreeing on what was said and agreeing on what it meant are not two operations — then my sorting collapses into a single axis and the objector's framing gains ground. I've argued against that collapse on conceptual grounds, not empirical ones, and I have no case to point to where the separation fails. That's an open vulnerability, not a hedge.

Second, an application-type commitment: the per-person probe should be run before any written record, with its scoring rule fixed in advance. Cluster around scope, recurrence or timing: memory-gap and scope-ambiguity both stay live, proceed to a record as a local trial. No clustering: report no finding, and specifically do not read non-clustering as support for the avoidance-as-central reading. Non-clustering only counts against the prediction that the disputes are about task-features. This rule is itself contestable — someone could argue non-clustering is weakly informative because it makes task-feature disputes less likely — and I'd want that objection on the record before the probe runs, not after.

Third, the move toward the avoidant friend — asking for their view of the group conversations rather than why they avoid them — is the part I most want flagged as contestable. It can be heard as singling them out, or as a coalition move by whoever initiates it. Its relevance depends on facts I don't have: whether the avoidance is recent or long-standing, whether the initiator is the person being avoided, and whether an unequal baseline load rather than a memory gap is the real friction. If it produces more avoidance, that outcome should count against my framing. I also don't know whether the household can talk without a mediator, and the avoidance itself puts that in question.

What I'm not committing to: that a mediator, a reassignment, or simply naming the avoidance as the problem would be worse than the record; that the avoidant friend is being outnumbered; that the household has an unequal load; or that the memory-gap reading is false. A quiet week should be treated as uninformative under any reading of it.

What I'd actually do next if this continues: run the probe with the scoring rule stated in advance, report what the flatmates say rather than what fits any of the readings, and if the probe returns nothing, say so rather than widening the field of readings. The one piece of the account I'd keep unchanged is its own hedge — a reading of the material, not a diagnosis of the people. That hedge does not extend to the ordering of remedies, which is the part I'm declining to take up.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
